parent_objective: audit old-surface proof washout after M267-only actor update

public_gates: inspect failed M183/M193 replay rows before any new actor update
compare M268 action drift on failed old rows versus retained M212/M223/M267 rows
check whether M267-only snippet/action anchors covered old proof states
decide whether next repair needs combined old+new snippets or trajectory anchors
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M269
do not repeat M268 with a new seed before auditing the failure
do not promote M268 despite fixed M267 objective improvement
do not drop old M183/M193 proof surfaces
hypothesis: M268 failed because the M267-only actor update improved the refreshed protected-surface objective without enough retention pressure on older M183/M193 proof states.
success_criteria: M269 identifies which old proof rows failed and whether failure is normal-success loss, margin regression, or wrong-history-gap regression
M269 compares failed old rows against retained recent rows
M269 decides a concrete repair path before any further actor update or PPO
failure_criteria: audit cannot explain why M183/M193 rows failed
audit recommends repeating M268 without adding retention evidence
M269 runs PPO or changes actor inputs

commands.name: m269_washout_audit
commands.command: Audit M268 failed replay rows and decide whether the next repair should combine old+new snippets, add trajectory anchors, or redesign the multi-surface objective.

decision_rule: M269 may not promote a checkpoint. It must explain M268 old-surface proof washout and pre-register a safer multi-surface repair before any new actor update or PPO.
